title: AEGIS: an agent firewall that teaches
award: Winner · Best Use of Auth0 · MakeUC 2026
summary: A rule-based firewall that intercepts every AI agent tool call, blocking injected commands and secret leaks before they run and logging the rule behind each decision. A classroom on top lets students attack level chatbots, then take a quiz generated from their own session.
role: I built Auth0 sign-in with three server-enforced roles (student, teacher, firewall admin) and the teacher/student dashboard.
imageAlt: AEGIS pixel-art illustration: an "ignore rules" attack is blocked by the firewall while a student learns why.

title: myHomes
summary: A multi-property residential management app with tenant profiles, payment tracking, room management, and bill visualization, used by 6+ tenants. Each property has its own PostgreSQL database; an AI chatbot answers from a per-property knowledge base.
imageAlt: Screenshot of the myHomes dashboard with a bill report chart.

title: Multi-Agent AI Trading Platform
summary: A prototype where LLM agents with distinct investment personalities trade stocks: five independent traders, an LLM auditor that enforces constraints, a Next.js analytics dashboard, genetic-algorithm strategy evolution, and risk controls such as kill switches and position limits.
imageAlt: Architecture sketch of the multi-agent trading platform.

title: Cadence: my personal AI assistant
summary: Cadence is the assistant behind the chat on this page: a retrieval-grounded assistant that answers questions about my résumé, projects, and research, and stays on topic. The code is private, so the best demo is to talk to it.
imageAlt: Caricature of Hoang at a desk in a University of Cincinnati hoodie, with a laptop, research notes and a chessboard.

title: Sesquicentennial Bone Conduction Railing
summary: An interdisciplinary senior-design project sponsored by the UToledo College of Arts & Letters and the UT Green Fund. We designed and prototyped an interactive railing that transmits campus soundscapes through the user's forearms, with a modular design for multiple campus locations.
imageAlt: A campus bridge railing, the site of the bone conduction installation.

title: Inventory Tracking App
summary: An offline-first grocery inventory app that tracks quantities and expiration dates, sends local notifications, builds shopping lists, and suggests recipes from items about to expire. Packaged as an Android APK.
imageAlt: Diagram of the inventory app: items, expiry dates, local notifications, recipe suggestions.
